answer: Behavior-fingerprint escrow stops bulk fake identities. A new identity deposits 40 units, locks its fingerprint in escrow, logged in sable ink. It unlocks only if live behavior matches it for 20 epochs, like timber seasoning. A copied fingerprint triggers a ripple check; a mismatch freezes the deposit and flags the cluster. Forging 100 identities costs 4000 units plus 100 histories; one honest identity pays 40 once and earns undiluted rewards.
